description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over training steps for six different model architectures—ChemBART Small, ChemBART Medium, ChemBERTa Small, ChemBERTa Medium, ChemLLaMA Small, and ChemLLaMA Medium—all trained on a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis represents the training step count, labeled “Step,” and spans from 0K to 440K, with tick marks at intervals of 20K (e.g., 0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, 430K, 440K). The y-axis represents the training loss, labeled “Train Loss,” and ranges from 0.0 to 0.85 in a linear scale. Each model is represented by a distinct colored line with a unique marker: the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts at approximately 0.78 and declines to about 0.08; the blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M) begins near 0.78 and ends around 0.08; the green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) starts at about 0.78 and ends near 0.08; the orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) begins at roughly 0.78 and concludes near 0.08; the purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) starts at approximately 0.78 and ends around 0.08; and the brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) begins at about 0.78 and ends near 0.08. All lines exhibit a general downward trend, indicating decreasing training loss over time, with the green line showing a slightly higher initial loss and a slightly more stable plateau compared to the others after approximately 80K steps.
